statement: On seed 119, free-omega LM-minimization of photometry over a forward A->C window (window-as-objective) escapes the hard-shoot trap and recovers Band A, where hard-connecting the endpoints gives Band D (rho 0.687). s106 first showed it oracle-seeded (rho 0.0300, omega-err 0.57deg, |omega| 1.5025 deg/s). s114 confirms it BLIND (no oracle pair; anchor-direct omega-multistart seeds the polish) and HI-FI-CONFIRMED (winner hi-fi-rho 1.534 Band A, omega-dir 1.64deg) with 0 phantoms across 150 polishes. SCOPE: N=1 (seed 119).
